title: The Shepherd Who Looked Up
old_p1: Amos was a herdman, which means he took care of animals. He also picked sycomore fruit, a kind of fig that grows on trees. Amos said he was not a prophet.
A prophet is someone Heavenly Father sends to tell His words. But while Amos followed his sheep, Heavenly Father said, “Go, and tell my people.” So Amos went.
old_p2: The people had stopped looking for Heavenly Father and were unkind to the poor. He said, “Seek ye me, and ye shall live.” Seek means look for.
Amos told them to seek the One who made the seven stars and Orion, bright groups of stars everyone could see. They show how great He is.
The same stars shine above your roof tonight. Heavenly Father made every one, and He is near when you look for Him.
p1: Amos was a herdman. A herdman takes care of animals, like sheep. Amos also picked figs from trees. He was not a prophet.
One day, Amos was following his sheep. Heavenly Father picked Amos. He said, “Go and tell my people my words.” So Amos went!
The people had stopped looking for Heavenly Father. Some of them were unkind to poor people.
p2: Heavenly Father told them, “Look for me, and you will live.” Amos said to look for the One who made the stars. He made a little group called the seven stars. He made a big group called Orion.
The same stars shine over your house tonight. Heavenly Father made every one. When you pray, you are looking for Him. Tonight you can say, “Thank You for the stars.”
